name: supply-chain
description: A department-based supply chain for coding agents: every non-trivial task passes through the department that owns it (frontend, backend, data, security, QA, devops, architecture, UX/UI, product, devex), which decides what to build, why, where and how, and which skills and MCP servers to use. Stack- and language-agnostic, self-indexing skill registry, per-user learning and project-specific skill generation.
